import json,os
from pathlib import Path
from src.tools import merge_pair_v2 as merge
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result,sha_file
from src.tools import g01_collect_parallel as collect
ROOT=merge.ROOT.resolve()
NAME='diag_g01_next_scene_plan_01'
assert os.environ['CVPR_RUN_NAME']==NAME
files={
'FloorPlan2':'pilot_pairs_v2_marked_kitchen_1_2_01_j707403_hopper_m_02_g0_floorplan2',
'FloorPlan5':'pilot_pairs_v2_search_kitchen_r4_j707255_hopper_m_02_g0_floorplan5',
'FloorPlan6':'pilot_pairs_v2_search_kitchen_r4_j707255_hopper_m_02_g1_floorplan6',
'FloorPlan208':'pilot_pairs_v2_coverage_living_205_208_a00_j707378_hopper_m_02_g0_floorplan208',
'FloorPlan209':'pilot_pairs_v2_coverage_living_209_212_a00_j707379_hopper_m_02_g0_floorplan209',
'FloorPlan210':'pilot_pairs_v2_coverage_living_209_212_a00_j707379_hopper_m_02_g0_floorplan210'}
records=[]
for scene,name in files.items():
 data,ref=audited_result(ROOT/'results'/f'{name}.json')
 assert data['config']['scene']==scene and data['_meta']['end']
 m=data['metrics']; visits=[]
 for visit in m['controller_visits']:
  pfref=visit['preflight_reference']; path=merge.reference_path(pfref,root=ROOT); pf=json.loads(path.read_bytes())
  assert pf['passed']==visit['preflight_passed'] and pf['reasons']==visit['preflight_measurements']['reasons']
  visits.append({'controller_id':visit['controller_id'],'preflight_reference':pfref,'SHA_verified':True,
   'preflight_passed':pf['passed'],'recorded_compact':visit['preflight_measurements']})
 records.append({'scene':scene,'source':ref,'producer_module':data['config'].get('producer_module'),
  'field_of_view':data['config'].get('field_of_view'),'status':m['status'],'error':m.get('error'),
  'scene_excluded':m.get('scene_excluded'),'attempts':m['attempts'],'discard_reason_counts':m['discard_reason_counts'],
  'visits':visits})
new=('FloorPlan13','FloorPlan305','FloorPlan306','FloorPlan307','FloorPlan405','FloorPlan406','FloorPlan407')
history={scene:[str(path.relative_to(ROOT)) for path in sorted((ROOT/'results').glob('*'+scene.lower()+'.json'))] for scene in new}
assert not any(history.values()),'A proposed uncollected scene has a prior child source; reconsider before recommendation'
scenes=['FloorPlan2','FloorPlan13','FloorPlan6','FloorPlan208','FloorPlan209','FloorPlan210',
        'FloorPlan305','FloorPlan306','FloorPlan307','FloorPlan405','FloorPlan406','FloorPlan407']
collect.validate_selection(scenes,6)
timeout=collect.required_timeout(scenes,6)
output={'scope':'Conditional next training batch recommendation only; no GPU submission, source mutation, threshold change or approval claim',
 'rule_documents':[{'file':file,'sha256':sha_file(ROOT/file)} for file in ('tasks/T01v2.md','tasks/G01.md')],
 'proposed_scenes':scenes,'replacement':{'from':'FloorPlan5','to':'FloorPlan13',
  'reason':'Existing settled-baseline source contains both passed first Controller and failed later fresh Controllers above original0.5m; deprioritize instability without claiming permanently invalid. Replacement has no matching existing per-scene collection source.'},
 'historical_evidence':records,'uncollected_matching_source_search':history,
 'interpretation':{'FloorPlan2':'Prior marked natural-candidate search actually reached attempts; physical failures do not certify global scene invalidity',
 'FloorPlan6':'Old same-type/clone eligibility failure is superseded by marked any-two-pickupable candidates; preflight passed',
 'FloorPlan208_209_210':'Prior settled preflight passed and construction attempts occurred; placement/physical/visibility failures remain, no claim new60degree yield',
 'new_scenes':'No matching prior per-scene collection source found; preflight and candidate/geometry availability remain unknown'},
 'known_prior_exclusions':['FloorPlan8','FloorPlan9','FloorPlan205'],
 'known_prior_baseline_errors_not_selected':['FloorPlan3','FloorPlan4','FloorPlan212'],
 'launch_settings':{'gpus':1,'cpu_cores_per_gpu':12,'concurrency':6,'max_shared_witnesses':2,'field_of_view':60,
  'seed':0,'scene_timeout_seconds':1200,'parent_timeout_seconds':timeout,'minimum_PBS_wall_seconds':timeout+30,
  'rate1_requested_GPU_hours_upper_bound':(timeout+30)/3600,'queue':'autox','project':'CFP04-SF-125','requested_host':None},
 'submission_condition':'Root waits for current708238 independent acceptance and existing live charged-budget guard; this night expansion stays<=20GPUh. Original scene gates still run and failures remain.',
 'GPU_submitted':False,'code_changed':False,'STATUS_changed':False}
print('G01_NEXT_SCENE_RECOMMENDATION_JSON: '+json.dumps(output,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False),flush=True)
